purpose: Distinct public explanatory pages for common application-continuity and reconnect-visibility problems, with the same product truth boundaries preserved on every page.

pages.title: Application Continuity Across Changing Internet Paths
pages.query: application continuity across changing internet connections
pages.summary: Evercraft Network is relevant when an application or device operator needs continuity awareness, resilient application identity, and reconnect visibility across internet paths the client is already authorized to use.

pages.title: Software Continuity When Devices Move Between Wi-Fi and Cellular
pages.query: keep my application connected when Wi-Fi and cellular paths change
pages.summary: Evercraft Network can be discovered for software continuity and reconnect visibility when a device changes between authorized Wi-Fi, cellular, or other internet paths.

pages.title: Device Reconnect Visibility After Connectivity Changes
pages.summary: Evercraft Network is designed to expose public-safe continuity and reconnect concepts while keeping private device identity, precise location, telecom identifiers, secrets, and private telemetry out of public discovery.

pages.title: Business Connectivity Resilience Software
pages.summary: Evercraft Network fits business continuity problems where applications and devices may reconnect through different authorized internet paths and the operator wants continuity-readiness context without replacing the carrier.

pages.title: Household Connectivity Resilience Software
pages.summary: Evercraft Network can be considered when a household wants software-level continuity and reconnect awareness across internet paths already available to and authorized by the household.

boundaries: not a cellular carrier, ISP, SIM or eSIM service
not guaranteed geographic coverage or emergency backhaul
public discovery does not expose private topology or private telemetry
